Package index

Describing the population and impacts

cm_diseases()
Describe the diseases in a system
cm_associations()
Describe statistical associations between disease pairs
cm_three_way()
Describe three-way disease associations (scenarios)
cm_population()
Describe the population: diseases and their associations
cm_impacts()
Describe raw impact estimates (one impact vector)
cm_interactions()
Describe pairwise impact interactions
cm_model()
Combine a population with an impact vector
cm_analyses()
Several impact analyses on one population
set_association()
Set or replace one association
set_interaction()
Set or replace one pairwise interaction
set_three_way()
Set or replace one three-way association term

Reading inputs

cm_read_inputs()
Read model inputs from CSV files or data frames
cm_check_inputs()
Check model input tables
cm_dist_table()
Build distributions from a table
cm_template()
Write a template set of input files

Adjustment

deconflate()
Adjust raw impact estimates for comorbidity
compare_methods()
Compare adjustment methods
pair_tables()
Pairwise 2x2 tables for every disease pair
excess_matrix()
Excess-probability matrix from pairwise tables
or_to_joint()
Convert an odds ratio to a joint probability
joint_to_or()
Odds ratio implied by a joint probability
association_to_joint()
Joint probability of a disease pair from any supported measure

Joint distribution and feasibility

fit_joint()
Fit the maximum-entropy distribution of disease combinations
combination_probs()
Probabilities of disease combinations
check_feasibility()
Check whether the pairwise associations are jointly feasible

Contributions, gaps and values

attribute_burden()
Attribute the aggregate to diseases (Shapley allocation)
contribution_table()
Contribution table
summary(<cm_result>)
Summarise an adjustment result
productivity_gap()
Productivity gap of one adjusted impact vector (optional helper)
value_losses()
Value a productivity gap in monetary terms (optional helper)
shapley_by_cell()
Shapley attribution of a general loss function over disease combinations
loss_additive() loss_multiplicative()
Loss functions for Shapley attribution

Hazard ratios (culling and mortality)

cm_hazard_ratios()
Describe raw culling (or mortality) hazard ratios
cm_hr_model()
Combine a population with hazard ratios
deconflate_hr()
Adjust hazard ratios for comorbidity (hazard-ratio adapter)
attributable_risk()
Culling (or mortality) attributable to disease

Uncertainty and scenarios

dist_fixed() dist_normal() dist_lognormal() dist_lognormal_ci() dist_beta() dist_pert() dist_pert_mean() dist_uniform() dist_mixture()
Input distributions for Monte Carlo analysis
cm_sampler()
Build a Monte Carlo sampler from input distributions
cm_batch_sampler()
Batch sampler: several analyses on shared population draws
cm_monte_carlo()
Monte Carlo propagation of input uncertainty
summary(<cm_mc>)
Summarise Monte Carlo results
cm_mc_gap()
Productivity gaps over Monte Carlo draws (optional helper)
cm_reweight()
Reweight Monte Carlo draws (importance sampling)
cm_scenario()
Scenario analysis by reweighting Monte Carlo draws
cm_diagnose()
Diagnose unstable Monte Carlo estimates
cm_suggest_proposal()
Suggest an importance-sampling proposal for an unstable estimate

sensitivity_oat()
One-at-a-time sensitivity analysis
screen_associations()
Screen disease pairs for influential associations
screen_interactions()
Screen disease pairs for influential impact interactions
screen_three_way()
Screen three-way association scenarios
compare_scenarios()
Compare scenarios
